title: Orbit readiness: phased KPI tracker & contingency runbook
body:
Overview:
This is a working product-ops tracker that combines a phased KPI sheet with an operational contingency runbook for the Q1 'Orbit' feature rollout. Purpose is to make go/no-go decisions observable at a glance and provide battle-tested playbooks for common failure modes (latency spikes, model regression, quota exhaustion, region outage).

Audience:
- Product Ops (owners of this doc)
- Eng leads (serving-runtime, infra, console)
- SRE & Support on-call
- GTM (launch comms)

Intent / How to use:
1) Update weekly KPI rows with latest numbers (automated ingest where possible — infra will wire up monitoring hooks).
2) Flag any KPI that crosses trigger thresholds in the "Trigger" column.
3) For flagged KPIs, follow the mapped runbook step and notify stakeholders using the Slack shortcut (/orbit-escalate).
4) At T-48 and T-4 hours before ramp, owners must confirm status in the "owner signoff" checklist.

Phased lanes (high-level):
- Canary (0–2% traffic): verify basic success metrics and safety filters
- Ramp (3–30%): monitor latency, error rates, cost per token, and quality signals
- Scale (31–100%): optimize batching/cache policies and mitigate sustained capacity issues

KPI tracker (rows — update each cadence, columns implied):
- KPI: 99th perc latency (ms) | Target: < 450ms | Trigger: > 600ms for 10m | Current: (fill) | Owner: infra-rt
- KPI: Error rate (5xx + model errors) | Target: < 0.5% | Trigger: > 1.5% for 5m | Current: (fill) | Owner: s-rep
- KPI: Token unit cost (USD/token) | Target: <= baseline*0.95 | Trigger: > baseline*1.25 | Current: (fill) | Owner: finance-ops
- KPI: Quality regression (eval set pass%) | Target: >= 95% | Trigger: drop >= 3pp vs baseline | Current: (fill) | Owner: applied-ml
- KPI: Throughput (req/s sustained) | Target: canary->10r/s; ramp->120r/s | Trigger: sustained < 70% capacity | Current: (fill) | Owner: serving-runtime
- KPI: Prefix cache hit rate | Target: >= 45% | Trigger: < 25% | Current: (fill) | Owner: runtime-opt
- KPI: Cost burn vs forecast (daily) | Target: within +/- 10% | Trigger: deviation > 25% | Current: (fill) | Owner: finance-ops
- KPI: Support SLA breaches (P1s) | Target: 0 | Trigger: >= 1 incident for >15m | Current: (fill) | Owner: support

Per-KPI quick mitigations (first 15 minutes):
- Latency spike: 1) Fallback route to smaller quantized model (switch via routing policy); 2) Increase GPU burst capacity (dedicated) or throttle new canary sessions; 3) Engage infra on-call to check node health
- Error surge: 1) Disable non-critical feature flags; 2) Rollback latest model version to previous verified; 3) Open urgent incident bridge
- Quality regression: 1) Pause rollout; 2) Run targeted evals on recent prompt set; 3) Revert or patch prompt transforms
- Cost overrun: 1) Enable aggressive batching and KV cache; 2) Switch to cheaper compatible model variant; 3) Pause non-essential background jobs

Readiness checklist (owners must mark Y/N at T-48, T-4, Go):
- Infra capacity validated against traffic profile (owner: infra)
- Canary test suite passed (owner: qa)
- Safety filters and PII scrubbers enabled (owner: privacy)
- Monitoring hooks ingested into console dashboards (owner: observability)
- Rollback toggles validated in console (owner: console-and-rollouts)
- Comms templates ready (owner: GTM)
- Incident bridge runbook attached and acknowledged (owner: SRE)
- Legal/compliance signoff for data residency (owner: security-and-compliance)

Decision matrix (quick):
- If any KPI trigger + no immediate mitigation -> PAUSE rollout and escalate to exec on-call.
- If trigger + mitigation successful within 30m and no regression in quality -> continue with reduced ramp for 24h.
- If repeated triggers across two independent KPIs -> ROLLBACK to previous model/route and open post-mortem.

Risk register (top 6):
1) Region outage during ramp — Mitigation: multi-region routing + fallbacks; SLA impact: degraded latency for 25% of traffic
2) Token cost surge due to unexpected prompt inflation — Mitigation: prompt-length enforcement + adaptive batching; SLA impact: budget overspend risk
3) Model quality regression after tokenizer change — Mitigation: gated model promotion + extended eval window; SLA impact: user-facing incorrect outputs
4) Autoscaler thrashing under bursty traffic — Mitigation: smoothing policies + reserve burst capacity; SLA impact: higher latencies
5) Compliance audit lag (private deployments) — Mitigation: pre-validated images and KMS proofs; SLA impact: delayed customer enablement
6) Support capacity gap during initial 72h — Mitigation: temporary rotations, dedicated escalation channel; SLA impact: slower P1 response

Communication playbook (when a trigger fires):
1) Pager to on-call SRE and infra lead
2) Post to #orbit-launch as: short summary + KPI snapshot + mitigation steps taken + required decisions
3) Update status doc and mark the KPI in the tracker as "in mitigation"
4) If escalated, exec on-call gets a direct DM with 1-line summary and link to bridge

Open questions / TODOs:
- Automate the "current" KPI ingestion from Prometheus and cost pipeline (sheet -> infra task: INFRA-1243).
- Confirm SLAs for dedicated burst capacity and pricing impact for finance (finance-ops to complete by 2025-11-18).
- Final GTM copy needs legal review on data residency claim (linked: confluence:PRD-2025-ORB-Launch).

Appendix (quick links & snippets):
- Slack shortcut: /orbit-escalate -> opens incident template and notifies SRE lead
- Prom query samples: 99p latency: hist_quantile(0.99, rate(api_latency_bucket[5m]))
- Eval harness: github:repos/redwood/evals/orbit-eval (PR #61)

Notes to self (Priya):
- Keep this doc intentionally terse - handoff board should be the single source of truth during launch window.
- After GA, convert the working checklist into a templated playbook component for future launches.

Last review notes (2026-02-20):
- Ethan filled initial current metrics for canary (latency and error); Maria validated safety filters; Samir created the auto-notify script (pending PR merge).
- Action: infra to wire Prom->sheet ingestion by 2026-03-01 or we keep manual cadence.
